title: Design: a category's page with its matrix grid read-only
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products And Services field shows.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, and no other.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows category A's row.

Step 2:

  • The breadcrumb reads Settings › Categories › and category A's name.
  • The title is category A's name, with a three-dot button and a white New Matrix button at the top right.
  • Under the title sit a Pricing Matrix picker with an info icon beside it, a QuickBooks Products And Services picker and a Tax Exempt checkbox.
  • Below, matrix A's name labels a read-only grid with an Edit button at its top right and no Price Part Simulator, as in picture 7.8.
  • The name, QuickBooks Products And Services and Tax Exempt of today's Edit Category dialog (picture 7.2) are all on the page.
